title: Lightweight Graph Neural Network-Driven Acoustic Anomaly Detection Method for Gas Pipeline Leakage Levels in Underground Utility Tunnels.
summary: On 960 acoustically measured samples from a simulated underground utility-tunnel platform, the paper trains a spatial-temporal graph neural network to classify three pipeline-leakage levels and reports repeated-split and ablation results. This is a controlled sensor-classification result, not validation in operating tunnels.
